comment.body: Thanks for the exact key-generation error. It matches the Settings-to-MWB communication symptom tracked in #50795, but the banner does not identify which check failed. Please reproduce once, comment `/bugreport`, and attach the newly generated ZIP immediately afterward. Please omit pairing keys from screenshots; do not disable peer verification or mix executables from different releases.
